text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho has an incredible Triple
Tiara run,
winning the Oka Sho, the
Japanese Oaks, and the
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in an effort to become the
representative of
her generation, she's
set out to run in the Queen
Elizabeth II
Cup too. However...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm exhausted. Gimme something sweet, Familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nope. Studying here is way more
convenient.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a little late, but I know you'll drag
me back
before curfew anyway, so it'll
be fine!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, come on, Familiar! I need
something sweet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm rustling up some sweet snacks for
Sweep
Tosho since she's been working
hard and racking
her brains over her
next race goal, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creeeak!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar... What was that noise?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep! Squeeeak! Thunk!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Argh! What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep, beep, beep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rush over to where Sweep Tosho is
squatting on
the floor. I lean closer to
try and identify the
source of the
sound...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: My hat?! What's it doing?!
choice_data_list: スイープ、貴方の帽子が！！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ears on Sweep Tosho's hat are
moving in a
bizarre manner.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma... M-my hat's broken...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, Sweepy. The spell I
cast on your
pointy hat has just gone a
bit wonky is all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
I can fix it right up with a touch of magic
in my
workshop! Just leave it to me,
dearie!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Let's have a look, shall we?
Um,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: （すっかり意気消沈している……）

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Would you like me to show you a little
secret?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I do think it'd be best if I showed
you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
I imagine it's all thanks to your
dedication that
my little Sweepy's been
enjoying racing so much
recently.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Don't you deny it. Her happiness beams
right out
of my television set. And I can
tell you trust her to
find that racing
magic of hers.
choice_data_list_en: No, no, it's nothing like that...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
But you must promise not to tell her
anything I'm
about to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: It's about her hat...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
I made it so that the ears move along
with hers
when she's wearing it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Just like Sweepy, I tend to get
quite into
things, you see, and one of
those things is
engineering. I picked it
up as a hobby.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
So... keep an eye on those ears for me so
they
don't get damaged again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
The more she applies herself, the more
her ears
move, and the more her hat's
ears move too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
But if her ears are moving about so much
that the
gears in her hat ears break...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. She might be demanding, but
she's not
one to show weakness.
choice_data_list: ……彼女が無理を押している証にもなる
choice_data_list_en: ...That's also proof she's pushing herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's how it was when she won the
Triple Tiara
too. She never expressed
any self-doubt
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter who she's up against or what
happens
mid-race, she sticks to her
running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She bides her time at the back and trusts
in
herself. She never stops believing that
she'll be
able to cast her magic on the
whole world...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the moment she crosses the finish
line in first,
she smiles as if to say, "See, I
did it."

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I do hope you'll stay by her
side.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: If she's with you, I know she'll be safe.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for casting another spell on my
hat,
Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! And this time I cast
some
multi-layered magic, so it won't
break again!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You really are the best witch in
the world!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text: Since we're all here, let's have some tea!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna have some lemon grass
tea! It's
on the shelf like always, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho runs off gleefully, seeming

drastically different from when we first
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I vow to continue watching over her so
that she'll
always be able to chase after
her magic with that
same skip in her
step.
